tagline: Get one alert when a condition changes — not one every cycle.
lore: Ravens travel with wolf packs, scouting ahead and calling out danger — here Alert Raven watches the sky while the pack hunts.
problem: The conditions that matter — credentialed coverage slipping, a new CISA KEV on your assets, certificates about to expire — change between the times anyone looks. Dashboards wait to be opened, and alerts that fire every cycle get muted.
does: Alert Raven watches navi.db for the conditions you choose and emails a digest when one newly fires. An alert is a number plus a condition: above or below a threshold, or a rise or drop since the last check. Start from a suggested pattern, or describe the alert in plain English, then test it before you save it.

glance.caption: Alert Raven's suggested patterns — credentialed coverage dropping, scans over 3 hours, new CISA KEV exposure, new critical findings, certificates expiring within 30 days, ownerless assets rising, EOL software rising — each one click to add, then test.

capabilities: credentialed-scan coverage, slow scans, new CISA KEV exposure, new criticals, certificates expiring within 30 days, ownerless assets, end-of-life software.
describe what to watch and Alert Raven drafts a read-only SQL metric, operator and threshold for review; without an AI model it builds the query from navi's tables.
a dry run shows the current value and whether it would fire — nothing is stored and nothing is sent.
an alert notifies when it goes from clear to firing, once, until it clears again — a lasting condition doesn't email every cycle.
everything that newly fired in one email, with the affected hosts, to an allowed recipient.
recent evaluations: what fired, what cleared, and the value each time.
how: Every metric is a read-only query over your local navi.db, or a built-in check (credential coverage uses the pack's shared credentialed rule). Alerts are saved locally. They are evaluated on demand or in the Contract's loop; the digest is sent with navi mail only when email is enabled (NAVI_EMAIL) and the recipient is allowed.
who: Vulnerability management leads and SOC teams who want to hear about a change without watching a dashboard all day.
better: Alert Raven watches the numbers the other hounds produce — Chronos's coverage, Laelaps's KEV, Certania's certificates, Atlas's ownership, Charon's EOL. Covenant runs its checks in the Contract loop, and the digest goes out through navi mail, the same path Gabriel uses.
cta: Let the raven watch the sky — you'll hear when something changes.
